input.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import json
import subprocess

# Call the MCP tool to list users
result = subprocess.run(
    ["mcp-cli", "call", "tracker", "list_users"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True
)

if result.returncode == 0:
    try:
        data = json.loads(result.stdout)
        print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
    except:
        print(result.stdout)
else:
    print("Error:", result.stderr)
EOF
